# Bundled fonts

The documentation bundles two open fonts for the site and the rendered diagrams:

| File | Family | Source | License |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `Inter-latin.woff2` | Inter | [Google Fonts](https://fonts.google.com/specimen/Inter), latin subset, v20 | SIL Open Font License 1.1 |
| `JetBrainsMono-latin.woff2` | JetBrains Mono | [Google Fonts](https://fonts.google.com/specimen/JetBrains+Mono), latin subset, v24 | SIL Open Font License 1.1 |

The license texts are `OFL-Inter.txt` and `OFL-JetBrainsMono.txt`. Inter is the sans-serif face for
prose and names; JetBrains Mono is the monospaced face for code, labels, relationship types,
property keys, and values.

To update a font, download the latin WOFF2 from Google Fonts, replace the file, and refresh the
license text if the upstream license changed.
